text: Every event. Every seat. In sync.
Browse what's on, filter by day or category,
and open the event you want.
Every venue has its own seat map.
One tap finds the best seats together, C5 and C6,
with the view from your seat and a live total of Rs 1,600.
and the ticket is ready, saved as a PDF and an image in one click.
Plans change? Find any booking in seconds.
Cancel it, and the seats are free again.
For organizers, SeatCraft spots schedule clashes before tickets go on sale,
suggests a fix, and publishes once the schedule is clear.
Three venues. One box office. Fully offline.
Great events start with a seat.
